note: Ozark RV park in the Sinkin Creek valley in Mark Twain National Forest country west of Bunker (1960 County Road 5630), reached by 2 miles of well-maintained gravel off Highway A; the operator warns that GPS routes via County Road 565 / Logger's Lake Road are not RV friendly. It markets itself to UTV/SxS riders, who ride out on forest and county roads; also floating, hiking and a fishing pond. Self check-in; sites are chosen on arrival. Seasonal and full-time monthly sites too. --Claude
summary: Changed fees $50-75 -> $35-60 (RoverPass engine: Electric Only $35/$40 Sat, Full Hookups $55/$60 Sat, all 2027 dates; holiday weekends $60-100 with a 2-night minimum). Added 50A full hookups, 31 sites, showers/wifi, RoverPass booking with holiday-only 2-night minimum, extra-person fees. Passes price/presence/long-stay; CRITERIA ask on its off-road branding (proposed keep as a general RV park).
flags: GATE FACTS (private): cheapest RV night $35 (Electric Only, RoverPass, Tue 2027-06-08 / 2027-09-14 / 2027-10-12 and Tue 2026-11-17); the full-hookup sites are $55 weeknights on the engine (not $50: the operator page's '$50/night Sun-Thu' is lower than the engine, not a pre-fee figure - RoverPass's $3.50 platform fee and card fee are added on top in the cart). Summer Tue 2027-06-08: $35 electric / $55 full; autumn Tue 2027-10-12: $35 / $55. Well under US$50. Google Maps 'Little Sinkin Creek RV Resort & Campground': 4.9 over 36 reviews, phone (573) 604-9427, site littlesinkincreek.com (gm.py 2026-11-09, unchanged). Presence: live operator site with rates and phone, claimed and bookable RoverPass listing. Gateways: none within 40 km (nearest St. Louis 162 km) - not needed at $35.

MINIMUM STAY: holiday-only. RoverPass minNightsRequired is 1 on every ordinary date read (weekdays and Saturdays, Memorial Day Saturday 2027-05-29 included) and 2 for July 4th (from 2027-07-03) and Labor Day (2027-09-04) weekends; the operator says 'Holiday Weekends: $75/night (2-night minimum ...)'.

LONG-STAY (five tests, passes): (1) it markets seasonal sites ('Only $400/month from March through November') and full-time sites ('Just $500/month', year-round) alongside nightly ones; (2) nightly rates posted on its own page and engine; (3) no homes or lots for sale; (4) on Tue 2026-11-17 RoverPass offered 17 of the 31 RV sites for one night (14 full-hookup + 3 electric) - over half sold nightly; (5) no approval needed (self check-in, instant booking). Mixed, but nightly in character.

CRITERIA ASK (off-road branding): the home page calls it 'Missouri's Premiere Offroad Campground' and 'Little Sinkin Creek RV Resort & UTV Campground', 'Built by Riders, for Riders', and the rules allow crossing 'the lower field to access Sasquatch Trail'. But it is a 31-site full-hookup RV park with rentals, tent sites, floating/hiking marketing and family rates, and the riding is on public 'forest roads, county roads, and legal trails' off site ('RV Park NOT a UTV Park' - its own rule). Proposed KEEP as a general campground with an OHV side (as Big Earl's 1200 / Lizzie and Charlie's 10171), caveat in the note; AWH to confirm.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): Sinkin Creek runs in a wooded channel along the park's south-east edge, ~30-60 m from the nearest pads behind a tree strip, and is too small to see through the canopy; the 'Creek & Pond Access' is a walk. The fishing pond between the loops is ~0.3 acre (a pond). Imagery 2026-11-09.
